name: Fuling Technology Co., LTD
summary: Fuling Technology Co., LTD engages in research, develops, produces, and sells plastic and paper tableware in China and internatinally. It offers plastic tableware, paper tableware, and biodegradable tableware including knives, forks, spoons, straws, water cups, small measuring cups, plates, cup lids, takeout boxes, takeout bowls, paper cups, and paper food containers. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Wenling, China. Fuling Technology Co., LTD is a subsidiary of Taizhou Zhenlong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
